name: Bilt Card

apr.notes: APR not visible on product or terms page; see cardholder agreement for current APR.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee not stated on fetched pages.

credit_required.notes: Bilt does not publish minimum score requirements.

rewards.redemption_notes: Bilt Points redeemable via 28 airline and hotel transfer partners (1:1 ratio), Bilt Travel Portal, future rent/mortgage payments, Lyft rides, fitness classes, statement credits, eligible student loan payments, and toward a home down payment. The Point Guy values Bilt Points at 2.2 cents each.

benefits.title: No transaction fee on rent, mortgage and HOA
benefits.description: Every Bilt Card lets you earn rewards on rent and mortgage payments made through Bilt with no transaction fee. Bypass landlord credit card fees via ACH, Venmo, PayPal, or check.

benefits.title: Bilt Neighborhood Dining bonus points
benefits.description: At Bilt Neighborhood Dining restaurants — 20,000+ participating locations — you earn bonus Bilt Points per dollar on top of your card's standard earn rate. No activation required.

benefits.title: Lyft bonus points
benefits.description: Linking Bilt and Lyft accounts earns an additional 2X Bilt Points per dollar on eligible rides. Blue cardholders earn 3X total on Lyft.

benefits.title: Bilt Travel Portal bonus points
benefits.description: Booking hotels earns +2X and flights +1X bonus Bilt Points on top of your card's base rate through the Bilt Travel Portal.

benefits.title: 28 airline and hotel transfer partners
benefits.description: Points transfer at a 1:1 ratio for Bilt travel partners, including major domestic and international airline programs and leading hotel loyalty programs.

notes: Verified against official Bilt Rewards page 2026-07-24. Page now describes Bilt Card 2.0 with three tiers (Blue/Obsidian/Palladium); this record maps to the no-annual-fee Bilt Blue Card. APR and FX fee not stated on fetched pages. No signup bonus advertised.
